votes.motion: A motion was made by Marci Houseman, seconded by Brooke D'Sousa, to approve the Consent Calendar

A motion was made by Alison Stroud, seconded by Marci Houseman, to adopt Ordinance #22-11, an ordinance amending and fixing the boundaries of a zone district of the Sandy City Zoning Ordinance; rezoning approximately 2.2 acres, involving five parcels, as proposed by the Applicant, generally located at 7635 S. 300 E. from the R-2-8 Zone ("Two-Family Residential District") to the PUD (12) Zone ("Planned Unit Development District")
